description: Formulation of Gross Domestic Product, Gross Value Added (GVA), Supply-Use Tables (SUT), and Sequence of Accounts following System of National Accounts 2008 standards.
Techniques for compiling quarterly national accounts, benchmark-indicator interpolation, and volume/price deflation methodologies.
Item basket weighting, Laspeyres/Geometric Mean index computation, rural/urban aggregation, and chain-linking procedures.
Monthly compilation of industrial output metrics, weighting diagrams, seasonal adjustment, and manufacturing sector tracking.
Multi-stage stratified sampling design, first-stage units (FSU) selection, listing schedule design, and non-sampling error control.
Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) workflow deployment, real-time field validation rules, and enumerator monitoring.
Data wrangling, automated tabular compilation, statistical imputation, and reproducible analytics using pandas, numpy, and tidyverse.
Application of machine learning algorithms for administrative data linkage, satellite data estimation, and predictive time-series forecasting.
MoSPI data quality principles, metadata standards (SDMX), audit guidelines, and official statistics code of practice.
Collection of Statistics Act (CSA) 2008 rules, data confidentiality safeguards, and inter-ministerial data governance protocols.
Alignment of UN Sustainable Development Goals with MoSPI NIF, metadata calculation, baseline tracking, and state-level dashboarding.
Sub-national disaggregation, gender statistics, Gini coefficient computation, and multidimensional poverty index calculations.
